beats.canonical: A new record confirms: Lydia Fern had a dispute with Henry Alder over ambition.
A new record confirms: Esther Wren concealed debt involving the Lounge at 22:30.
A suspect asks to leave. The clock advances five minutes.

suspects.actingNotes: Measured, warm, then clipped under pressure.
suspects.name: Lydia Fern
suspects.persona: botanist. Careful with words; fiercely protective of colleagues.
suspects.secret: Lydia forged a specimen label to protect her scholarship.

suspects.actingNotes: Low and direct, with short pauses.
suspects.name: Simon Vale
suspects.persona: gardener. Practical and impatient with ceremony.
suspects.secret: Simon took seeds to plant in the workers' garden.

suspects.name: Esther Wren
suspects.persona: secretary. Polite, proud, and anxious about money.
suspects.secret: Esther hid a loan used to pay her father's rent.

suspects.actingNotes: Quiet wit; the smile fades when challenged.
suspects.name: Rupert Hale
suspects.secret: Rupert overheard a private committee meeting.
